scripts.build:workers: cargo build --release -p forge_editor_core -p forge_asset_worker -p forge_shader_worker -p forge_build_worker -p forge_runtime -p forge_renderer_worker
scripts.build: npm run build:workers && tsc && vite build
scripts.build:editor: npm run build:workers && tsc && vite build --mode editor
